gloss: to be able to, to be possible

definitions.explanation: Expresses ability or possibility. Often used with nouns or the potential meaning of verbs.

definitions.gloss: to be completed, to be made
definitions.explanation: For something to come into existence or be finished.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}ができますか？
examples.notes: Ability with noun + ができる
Verb dictionary form + ことができる

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいビルができました。

notes: An essential verb for expressing ability. With nouns: [noun]ができる. With verbs: [dictionary form]ことができる. Can also mean 'to be made of' as in {木|き}でできている (made of wood).
